info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update P2m By Param1-spec
info.description: The Update P2M Webhook Endpoint API allows businesses to modify the configuration of a specific webhook endpoint identified by a parameter. This operation is essential for ensuring that webhook settings are aligned with current business needs and can adapt to changes in data handling or service integration. Developers typically use this API to update settings related to notification delivery, error handling, or payload structures. By enabling dynamic updates, this API supports efficient management of webhook interactions.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific webhook endpoint identified by its unique resource ID. Provide the necessary updates in the request body to modify the existing webhook endpoint settings.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of the specified webhook endpoint identified by RES-100045. The payload should conform to the schema defined for the operations related to this endpoint.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the resource has been updated.
